intent: A non-modal inspector dialog, docked beside the inspector rail, holding a target's saved export settings: filename suffix, color profile, image resampling, and overlapping-layer handling.
guidance: Open it from the inspector's export trigger; it renders through InspectorDialog, so it docks to the inspector surface's left edge with an 8px gutter (not to the trigger) and lands clear of the panel at any width (#499). Non-modal: the canvas stays live, focus is not trapped, and Escape, the close X, or an outside click all call onClose. Drive it fully controlled — pass value and emit committed patches via onChange; the dialog keeps no state. Omit onChange or pass readOnly to lock an inherited/locked selection: every field disables and a polite live region explains why. Keep it to these four saved knobs — job-time parameters (scope, presets, range, preflight) belong to the full Export flow, not this surface.

anatomy.description: The portalled non-modal floating panel from InspectorDialog: 240px wide (COMPACT_INSPECTOR_DIALOG_WIDTH), rounded-c-lg, bg-c-bg, elevation/400, docked the 8px gutter clear of the inspector surface's left edge; draggable and edge-aware.
The 40px title bar (border-b border-c-border, pl-[16px] pr-[8px]); the dialog's first child, so it doubles as the drag handle.
The "Export" h2 (hand-rolled text-[11px] font-[550], text-c-text) at the header's left.
24px button, aria-label "Close export settings", 16px X glyph in icon/secondary, rounded-c-md, hover bg-c-bg-hover. Calls onClose.
96px label column beside a medium InputField for the filename suffix; empty renders the "None" placeholder. min-height 32px.
96px label beside a full-width Dropdown opening a radio menu — sRGB (same as file) / sRGB / Display P3 / Unmanaged.
96px label beside a full-width Dropdown opening a radio menu — Detailed / Bilinear / Nearest neighbor.
A trailing Checkbox toggle (pt-[8px]) labeled "Ignore overlapping layers".

use_when: Editing a target's persistent export settings from the inspector — suffix, color profile, resampling, and overlap handling.
You need a small settings surface docked beside the inspector rail that leaves the canvas interactive while it's open.
dont_use_when: Running an export job with scope, presets, range, or a preflight review — that is the full Export flow, not this saved-settings surface.
A blocking, focus-trapping confirmation — use Modal.
A free-standing option list with no dialog chrome — use Menu / Dropdown.

slots.trigger: The launch control (a ReactElement) the dialog anchors to and captures; focus returns here on close.

Row label.font: hardcoded text-[11px] leading-[16px] font-[450] on var(--composa-font-family)

tokens.note: No #hex color in source — every color binds to a c-* token. Unlike the shared InspectorDialogHeader, this dialog hand-rolls its header, so the title and row labels use hardcoded px sizes/weights (text-[11px], font-[550]/[450], leading-[16px]) rather than the --composa-body-* type tokens. Spacing is hardcoded px (header 40, body inset 12, row gap 4, row min-height 32, label column 96, control gap 8); the 240px width, 8px surface-anchored gutter (TYPE_SETTINGS_INSPECTOR_SIDE_OFFSET) and elevation 400 come from shared InspectorDialog constants (COMPACT_INSPECTOR_DIALOG_WIDTH, COMPOSA_INSPECTOR_SURFACE_SELECTOR).

a11y.role: dialog — non-modal (aria-modal=false, no focus trap). The role is rendered by the InspectorDialog / AnchoredInspectorOverlay surface this component composes, so ariaRole is enforced.
a11y.label: aria-label "Export" names the dialog (there is no title-element association).
a11y.close: The header X is a <button aria-label="Close export settings">; Escape and outside-click also call onClose.
a11y.controls: Each option Dropdown carries aria-haspopup="menu" and a descriptive aria-label (e.g. "Color profile: sRGB") and opens radio menu rows (selectionRole="radio", checked); the InputField is a labelled text field and the Checkbox a labelled toggle.
a11y.readOnly: When locked, an aria-live="polite" sr-only note announces "Unlock the selection to edit export settings."; every field is disabled.
a11y.focus: Non-modal — focus is not trapped; the canvas stays interactive and focus returns to the trigger on close.

code.example:
<ExportDialog
  open={open}
  trigger={<IconButton icon={<Download />} ariaLabel="Export settings" />}
  value={{ suffix: '', colorProfile: 'sRGB (same as file)', imageResampling: 'Detailed', ignoreOverlappingLayers: false }}
  onChange={patch => commit(patch)}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
/>
